verses.text: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that fire may burn up your cedars!
Wail, you juniper trees, because the cedar has fallen. The majestic trees are ruined! Wail, you oaks of Bashan, because the thick forest has been cut down!
Listen to the wailing of the shepherds! Their rich pastures are ruined. Listen to the roaring of the young lions! The lush thickets of the Jordan are destroyed.
This is what the LORD my God says: "Take care of the flock that is set aside to be slaughtered.
Those who buy them kill them and are not punished. Those who sell them say, 'Praise the LORD, I am rich!' Even their own shepherds have no pity on them.

For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land," says the LORD. "I will hand everyone over to their neighbors and to their king. They will crush the land, and I will not rescue anyone from their power."
So I took care of the flock set aside to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two shepherd's staffs. I named one Favor and the other Union, and I took care of the flock.
In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. I grew tired of the sheep, and they hated me too.
So I said, "I will not be your shepherd anymore. Let the dying die and the lost be lost. Let those that are left eat one another's flesh."
Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, breaking the covenant I had made with all the nations.
It was broken that same day. Then the oppressed of the flock who were watching me knew that this was a message from the LORD.
I said to them, "If you think it is right, pay me my wages. If not, keep them." So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.
Then the LORD said to me, "Throw it to the potter, that fine price they thought I was worth!" So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
Then I broke my second staff, called Union, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.
Then the LORD said to me, "Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

I am going to raise up a shepherd over the land who will not care for the lost, look for the young, heal the injured, or feed the healthy. Instead, he will eat the meat of the fattest sheep and tear off their hooves.
"How terrible it will be for the worthless shepherd who abandons the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered and his right eye totally blind!"
